message: Strapping pin: GPIO 0 must be HIGH during boot (pulled up by default). If driven LOW externally, the chip enters bootloader mode.
Storage variable `boot_count` is never saved, so it resets to its default on every boot.
`wifi.connect` has no fallback if it fails.
hint: Without one the program carries on offline. Add `or retry(5)` to try again, `or skip` to carry on, or `or restart` to reboot.
